entities.name: PMID:25069535
observations: In healthy male Fischer 344 rats, aerosolized L-Ile-Thia and L-Val-Pyrr showed distinct surfactant-protein expression patterns.

entities.name: Differential surfactant response
observations: L-Ile-Thia increased SP-A mRNA at 6 h and SP-D mRNA at 6 h; L-Val-Pyrr increased SP-D mRNA at 3 and 6 h and SP-B mRNA at 3 and 6 h.
L-Val-Pyrr significantly increased SP-A, SP-B, and SP-C protein at 6 h; reported abstract provides no effect sizes or significant SP-D protein increase.
